subject: Hosted API: volume discount structure and SKU breakdown for model mix
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam@brightbeam.ai>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: BrightBeam Procurement <procurement@brightbeam.ai>
Date: 2026-05-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Hosted API pricing details and commit questions

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for the quick demo yesterday — really helpful. Procurement asked me to follow up with a few concrete questions so we can evaluate Redwood for the BrightBeam inference layer:

1) We want hosted API pricing, usage-based. Can you confirm current list per-token rates for:
   - standard chat generation (gpt-like standard model)
   - premium chat (larger / proprietary model variants)
   - embeddings (encoder-only vs chat embeddings if different)

2) How are volume discounts expressed? Is it purely % off per-token based on monthly commit tiers, or do you have sliding tiers applied post-billing?

3) For our expected mix (~70% embeddings, 30% chat) can you provide an example commit tier and what effective per-token rates would look like at 50M, 200M, and 1B tokens/month?

4) Any constraints on model-specific pricing (i.e., premium models billed at a multiplier)? Are embeddings always a separate SKU?

5) Do you offer any time-limited promotional credits or ramp discounts for the first quarter of committed usage?

I've attached a quick volume/mix spreadsheet. We're trying to compare total monthly cost with a couple of other vendors and surface any nuances (billing minimums, overage behavior, model-specific surcharges).

Appreciate a consolidated quote or a draft MA/commit sheet we can pass to procurement.

Cheers,
Liam
Director of ML Ops
BrightBeam

[Attachment: brightbeam_pricing_needs.xlsx (xlsx, 14KB)]

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@brightbeam.ai>
Cc: priya_natarajan@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-05-05T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing details and commit questions

Hi Liam — thanks for the clear list. Answers below and I attached a draft quote for BrightBeam to review. I'm copying Priya (pricing) and Aditya (enterprise deals) for any special concessions.

Executive summary (hosted API, usage-based):
- Base list (per-token, token = approx 4 chars)
  • Standard chat models: $0.0008 / token
  • Premium chat models: $0.0024 / token (3x multiplier typical for premium variants)
  • Embeddings (encoder-only): $0.0006 / token
  • Chat-derived embeddings (if you use chat model for embeddings): treated as premium token pricing unless we provide a dedicated embeddings SKU

- Discount mechanics:
  • Commit tiers: we offer volume commit tiers (monthly) that reduce per-token price by a flat percentage applied to the list rate for that SKU.
  • Example tiers: 0-10M (0% off), 10M-100M (15% off), 100M-500M (25% off), 500M+ (35% off).
  • Discounts apply per SKU; model-specific multipliers remain on the list price before discounts.
  • Overflow/overage: usage above committed tier is billed at list minus the committed-tier discount for that SKU (no surprise spike).

- Model-specific notes:
  • Premium models are billed with a multiplier (commonly 3x) on the underlying list rate. The commit discount is then applied to that multiplied list price.
  • We surface embeddings as a separate SKU; if BrightBeam wants a dedicated embeddings-only rate (given your 70% embeddings mix), we can propose a narrower SKU and apply slightly improved discounts at scale.

Illustrative effective rates for your requested volumes (assuming 70/30 embeddings/chat mix and 2:1 split between standard/premium chat within the chat portion):
  • 50M tokens/month: embeddings 35M, chat 15M => effective embedding rate ~ $0.00051/token (15% tier), effective chat rate mix ~ $0.00148/token (weighted). Estimated monthly: ~$28,000
  • 200M tokens/month: embeddings 140M, chat 60M => embeddings likely in 100M-500M tier (25% off) => ~ $0.00045/token, chat weighted ~ $0.0018/token. Estimated monthly: ~$95,000
  • 1B tokens/month: embeddings 700M, chat 300M => embeddings in 500M+ tier (35% off) => ~ $0.00039/token, chat weighted ~ $0.00156/token. Estimated monthly: ~$420,000

Promotional / ramp options:
- We can offer a 3-month ramp discount that increases the effective discount by an additional 10 percentage points on top of the committed tier for the first 90 days (aimed at reducing your initial run rate while you ramp).
- We also provide a one-time $10k credit for pilots above $20k/month evaluated by sales leadership (requires a short exec approval).

Next steps I need from you to formalize a draft MA:
1) Confirm expected committed monthly token amount and desired term (6/12/24 months).
2) Confirm whether BrightBeam wants a single blended SKU or separate SKUs (embeddings vs chat).
3) Any procurement constraints (PO cadence, required CLA/contract language).

Attached: draft_quote_BB-2026-0505.pdf (includes line-item breakout and proposed ramp).

If you want, I can put together two scenarios (blended vs embeddings-specialized) and the explicit per-SKU math for procurement. Happy to hop on a quick call this week.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0187

[Attachment: redwood_draft_quote_BB-2026-0505.pdf (pdf, 48KB)]

From: Liam O'Connor <liam@brightbeam.ai>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: BrightBeam Procurement <procurement@brightbeam.ai>
Date: 2026-05-05T12:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing details and commit questions

Vanessa — huge thanks, that framing helps. A few follow-ups:

- We're inclined toward a separate embeddings SKU given the 70% mix. Can you send the explicit per-SKU math for the 200M and 1B scenarios (line items we can drop in our TCO model)?
- For premium-model multiplier: is 3x fixed per model or negotiable by model class? We have a small portion of traffic that needs high-quality summarization (premium) — would appreciate a lower multiplier if we commit to a minimum premium spend.
- Can you confirm ramp discount is stackable with the commit-tier discount (i.e., if we qualify for 25% commit discount + 10pp ramp, does that mean 35% total for first 90 days)?
- Procurement asked whether Redwood will consider a short-term promotional embedding price of $0.00035/token for the first 90 days if we agree to a 12-month total commitment (they want to show cost savings to execs).

We can commit to a 12-month term and target 200M tokens/month in months 4-12, with a 3-month ramp from pilot to steady state.

Would you be able to get an internal approval for the promotional embedding price + a softened premium multiplier? If so, procurement would like that in writing to proceed with a PO.

Thanks,
Liam

Date: 2026-05-06T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Hosted API pricing details and commit questions — approval request (BrightBeam)

Aditya / Priya — looping you in for quick approval. BrightBeam (Liam O'Connor) is asking: a promotional embeddings price of $0.00035/token for first 90 days if they sign 12 months with target 200M/mo (steady state months 4-12). They've also asked for a softened premium multiplier (from 3x -> 2.25x) if we include a guaranteed minimum premium spend of $25k/month.

Key constraints:
- This is for hosted API (no dedicated capacity).
- We'll bill overage at committed discount rate.
- We should include the 3-month ramp stacking behavior (i.e., ramp gives +10pp on top of committed tier for months 1-3). Liam is explicit that procurement wants the promotional embedding rate in writing.

Proposed commercial concession to offer (if you agree):
1) Promotional embeddings price: $0.00035/token for months 1-3 (requires 12-month commitment, target 200M/month steady state).
2) Temporary premium multiplier reduction: premium models billed at 2.25x list (instead of 3x) provided BrightBeam commits to minimum premium spend $25k/month averaged across months 4-12.
3) Require PO and signed MA before promotional pricing is applied.

If you approve, I'll send a formal redlined quote and request Legal to add a short concession clause.

Forwarding with full thread below.

--
Vanessa
